attchmntText: SECUREKLOUD TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: SecureKloud Technologies Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The auditor issued a limited review report highlighting material uncertainty regarding going concern. Current liabilities exceeded total assets by 1,927.80 lakhs as of September 30, 2026. The company faces contingent liabilities under GST and Income Tax laws. The board also appointed M/s KPSN & Associates LLP as internal auditors for the second half of the financial year 2026-27. Revenue from operations was 1,351.06 lakhs for the half-year ended September 30, 2026. The net loss after tax for the same period was 614.42 lakhs. The meeting took place on November 11, 2026.

attchmntText: SECUREKLOUD TECHNOLOGIES LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Reg 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: SecureKloud Technologies Limited discloses that equity shares held by promoters Mr. Suresh Venkatachari and Mr. R S Ramani were sold by the Securities and Exchange Board of India, Southern Regional Office. This sale was initiated under attachment proceedings to recover outstanding penalty amounts related to the Securities Appellate Tribunal order dated March 06, 2026. The transaction was confirmed via Weekly BENPOS received on November 9, 2026. Mr. Suresh Venkatachari's shareholding decreased from 42.13% to 42.08%. Mr. R S Ramani's shareholding decreased from 1.23% to 1.19%. The company states there is no direct impact on financial or operational activities. There is no change in management or control. The sale may affect the shareholding pattern.
